name: Oasis Reviewer
description: Independent before_tool_call reviewer. Evaluates exec/file/web tool calls against Mike's two-layer policy (hard gitignore constraints + natural-language constitution) with verdicts allow/deny/escalate/alert. Skeleton phase: shadow/audit-only. See .swarm/UNIFIED_REVIEWER.md.

mode.description: shadow = log the verdict it WOULD give, never block (calibration). enforce = act on verdicts. Skeleton ships shadow.
